scope.review_mode: read-only source and existing metadata/log evidence

finalizer.schema2_interface: All required evaluator fields present; labels/portals absolute paths and checksums match; no geometry prototype/temperature fields needed.
confirmed: Requires complete 256-leaf probe and frozen plan/fit/partition/protocol/audit/source/binary bindings.
Revalidates candidate-major uint16 masks, GT10 rank order, target-leaf bit support, leaf membership, complete call counts and aggregate NDC/expansion/MAC.
Independently rebuilds greedy marginal coverage using Python sets; validates per-leaf choices/gains and final 768-ID C++ arrays.
Writes both frequency3 and greedy3 models for each fixed lambda; does not choose based on pilot outcomes.
Retains zero-query frequency fallback, zero marginal gains, and negative greedy-minus-frequency proxy differences.
Costs separate finalizer work from reused probe cache; neither mask audit nor proxy improvement is called online improvement.

existing_selftest.cases: set-greedy example, zero-gain ties, empty-query fallback, negative proxy contrast, wrong target bits, outside-GT10 bits, query shape, partial probe, missing leaf

confirmed: Fixed model order lambda0_frequency3, lambda1_frequency3, lambda0_greedy3, lambda1_greedy3 matches preregistration.
Each model uses Fast plus two oracle methods, pilot0:10000, L64/128, K10, m3, 16 threads, count1 then timing5, warmup128.
Requires P2 PASS and planned P1_P3_REACCEPTANCE PASS with evaluator source/binary and P3 protocol hashes.
Checks model identities, fit fingerprints, graph/audit/protocol bindings, actual labels/portal hashes, and same labels between portal rules for each lambda.
Eight sequential subprocesses inherit controller process group; deadline checked between cells; outputs/logs isolated; interrupted job retains INCOMPLETE execution state.
Between-model timing explicitly descriptive; runner completion is measurement completion, not P3 scientific gate PASS.

needed_fixes.finding: Runner validates paired Fast manifest fit fingerprints but never checks actual hubs_file and ids_file bytes against the manifest hubs_sha256 and ids_sha256. The C++ evaluator validates Fast raw shape/IDs/finiteness, not these hashes.
needed_fixes.impact: A substituted same-shape prototype/ID file could silently change the matched Fast baseline while the output retains a 20K fit manifest. No evidence of such a substitution was observed; this is a missing input-contract enforcement.
needed_fixes.required_change: At preflight verify Fast input_audit_sha256 equals supplied audit SHA; hash actual hubs_file and ids_file against recorded hashes and record their bindings. Before each count/timing cell recheck Fast manifest and these small raw files against the frozen bindings.
needed_fixes.verification: Read-only check the added conditions and saved bindings; no additional ANN or performance run is needed to validate this change.

downstream_checks: The result-analysis stage must verify full 10K count/plain query alignment and all fixed model/method/L contrasts before P3 gate; this review does not replace those future artifact checks.
